name: Surviving High School 11
source: Join millions who are totally addicted to this text-based adventure where your choices change your game.Play a variety of episodes with new characters, choices, and challenges. Throw the best party ever, deal with a big break-up, ace pop quizzes, and more! You control the action, but remember, some choices are wiser than others.
